$comment: ChatGPT Apps manifest template for Travel Booking Agent by Onegent. Verify against the latest schema at https://platform.openai.com/docs/apps before submitting — the field names below target the MCP-era Apps SDK spec and may need adjustment.
name: Travel Booking Agent
description: Book restaurants, hotels, flights, and activities through an AI agent that navigates real booking sites.
longDescription: Onegent — AI books your trip end-to-end. Ask for a restaurant reservation, hotel stay, flight, or activity in natural language, and this app hands off to Onegent's agent, which navigates OpenTable / Booking.com / Expedia / Viator on your behalf. The agent always stops before submitting your credit card's CVV — you confirm the final charge. Typical booking completion: 30-240 seconds depending on venue.
safetyNotes: Never submits CVV on behalf of the user — all bookings pause at payment for explicit user authorization.
All bookings are confirmable; see get_job_status + get_job_audit for full trace.
API keys can be scoped to specific booking scenarios and revoked at any time.
